rationale: The official corrected PDF cover and p.2 explicitly label a corrected first edition, with the same Scientific Opinion No. 15 identity and 27 March 2024 issue date. Researcher comparison against the two preserved original first-edition copies (ALLEA and KNAW, linked from the parent record) establishes an original-to-corrected relationship: all 102 corresponding pages were text-extracted, with non-whitespace differences on 22 page pairs and inspected wording changes on PDF pp.13,27,34. This is an analytical inference from the official correction label plus original-content comparison, not a publisher-issued errata schedule, an assertion of typography-only changes, or an explanation of why each edit was made.
